title: SandboxProfileSet
description: Result of the sandbox.profile.set JSON-RPC method: the workspace's newly written explicit profile (design 2026-08-23 §4.3). The revision is the new per-workspace optimistic-concurrency token. Paths are PrivateMetadata and appear only in this explicit result.

workspaceId.description: The named workspace whose profile was written.

revision.description: The new monotonic per-workspace revision after the write.

writablePaths.description: The canonicalized, validated read-write paths as stored.

readOnlyPaths.description: The canonicalized, validated read-only paths as stored.
